versions.changelog:
Initial release: Seamless access to Trustpilot business and review data via Scavio API.

- Search Trustpilot businesses by name, keyword, or category in any country.
- Retrieve detailed business profiles: TrustScore, star ratings, contact info, rating distribution, AI summary, and more.
- Page through and filter Trustpilot reviews with multiple criteria including language, stars, and topics.
- Browse the full Trustpilot category tree and see top businesses by category.
- Fetch individual Trustpilot reviews and all available details.
- All endpoints return structured JSON; requires a Scavio API key (50 free credits to start).
